title: ERP Upgrade & Fit-Gap Advisor: sourced ERP facts for selection, fit-gap and Odoo 20 upgrades (Claude Code plugin and MCP server)
description: Open-source Claude Code and Cursor plugin with a read-only MCP server. It provides dated and sourced ERP facts for ERP selection, requirement-by-requirement fit-gap analysis, Odoo 20 migration planning, 5-year cost and integrator quote review, and French e-invoicing platform checks. Methodology and context: https://www.jaikin.eu/migration-erp-pme
